passages.text: Behold, a day of the LORD is coming when your plunder will be divided in your presence.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD announces a coming day.
This day belongs to the LORD.
On that day, something important will happen.
Your plunder will be divided.
This will happen while you are present.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֥ה יֽוֹם־ בָּ֖א לַֽיהוָ֑ה וְחֻלַּ֥ק שְׁלָלֵ֖ךְ בְּקִרְבֵּֽךְ׃

passages.text: For I will gather all the nations for battle against Jerusalem, and the city will be captured, the houses looted, and the women ravished. Half of the city will go into exile, but the rest of the people will not be removed from the city.
passages.sermon:
God will gather all the nations.
God will bring them to Jerusalem for battle.
The nations will fight against Jerusalem.
The city will be captured.
Enemies will loot the houses.
Enemies will harm the women.
Half of the city’s people will go into exile.
The rest of the people will remain in the city.
God will not remove the rest from the city.
passages.original: וְאָסַפְתִּ֨י אֶת־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֥ם׀ אֶֽל־ יְרוּשָׁלִַם֮ לַמִּלְחָמָה֒ וְנִלְכְּדָ֣ה הָעִ֗יר וְנָשַׁ֙סּוּ֙ הַבָּ֣תִּ֔ים וְהַנָּשִׁ֖ים תִּשָּׁגַלְנָה וְיָצָ֞א חֲצִ֤י הָעִיר֙ בַּגּוֹלָ֔ה וְיֶ֣תֶר הָעָ֔ם לֹ֥א יִכָּרֵ֖ת מִן־ הָעִֽיר׃

passages.text: Then the LORD will go out to fight against those nations, as He fights in the day of battle.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD will go out.
The LORD will fight against those nations.
The LORD will fight as He does in the day of battle.
passages.original: וְיָצָ֣א יְהוָ֔ה וְנִלְחַ֖ם בַּגּוֹיִ֣ם הָהֵ֑ם כְּי֥וֹם הִֽלָּחֲמ֖ו בְּי֥וֹם קְרָֽב׃

passages.text: On that day His feet will stand on the Mount of Olives, east of Jerusalem, and the Mount of Olives will be split in two from east to west, forming a great valley, with half the mountain moving to the north and half to the south.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
On that day, the LORD will stand on the Mount of Olives.
The Mount of Olives is east of Jerusalem.
The Mount of Olives will split in two.
The mountain will split from east to west.
A very great valley will form.
Half of the mountain will move north.
Half of the mountain will move south.
passages.original: וְעָמְד֣וּ רַגְלָ֣יו בַּיּוֹם־ הַ֠הוּא עַל־ הַ֨ר הַזֵּתִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִַם֮ מִקֶּדֶם֒ וְנִבְקַע֩ הַ֨ר הַזֵּיתִ֤ים מֵֽחֶצְיוֹ֙ מִזְרָ֣חָה וָיָ֔מָּה גֵּ֖יא גְּדוֹלָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וּמָ֨שׁ חֲצִ֥י הָהָ֛ר צָפ֖וֹנָה וְחֶצְיוֹ־ נֶֽגְבָּה׃

passages.text: You will flee by My mountain valley, for it will extend to Azal. You will flee as you fled from the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. Then the LORD my God will come, and all the holy ones with Him.
passages.sermon:
God will make a valley through the mountains.
This valley will reach to Azal.
You will escape through this valley.
You will run away just as you ran from the earthquake.
That earthquake happened during the days of Uzziah, king of Judah.
Then the LORD, who is my God, will come.
All the holy ones will come with Him.
passages.original: וְנַסְתֶּ֣ם גֵּֽיא־ הָרַ֗י כִּֽי־ יַגִּ֣יעַ גֵּי־ הָרִים֮ אֶל־ אָצַל֒ וְנַסְתֶּ֗ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר נַסְתֶּם֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הָרַ֔עַשׁ בִּימֵ֖י עֻזִּיָּ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֑ה וּבָא֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֔י כָּל־ קְדֹשִׁ֖ים עִמָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: On that day there will be no light, no cold or frost.
passages.sermon:
On that day, God will act.
There will be no light.
There will be no cold.
There will be no frost.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא לֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֣ה א֔וֹר יְקָר֖וֹת יִקְפְּאוּן׃

passages.text: It will be a day known only to the LORD, without day or night; but when evening comes, there will be light.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God over all the earth.
There will be one special day.
Only the LORD will know this day.
This day will not be like other days.
It will not be day.
It will not be night.
When evening comes, there will be light.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֣ה יוֹם־ אֶחָ֗ד ה֛וּא יִוָּדַ֥ע לַֽיהוָ֖ה לֹא־ י֣וֹם וְלֹא־ לָ֑יְלָה וְהָיָ֥ה לְעֵֽת־ עֶ֖רֶב יִֽהְיֶה־ אֽוֹר׃

passages.text: And on that day living water will flow out from Jerusalem, half of it toward the Eastern Sea and the other half toward the Western Sea, in summer and winter alike.
passages.sermon:
On that day, the LORD will act.
The LORD will send living water out from Jerusalem.
Half of the water will flow to the Eastern Sea.
The other half will flow to the Western Sea.
This will happen in summer.
This will also happen in winter.
The living water will flow all year.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יֵצְא֤וּ מַֽיִם־ חַיִּים֙ מִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם חֶצְיָ֗ם אֶל־ הַיָּם֙ הַקַּדְמוֹנִ֔י וְחֶצְיָ֖ם אֶל־ הַיָּ֣ם הָאַחֲר֑וֹן בַּקַּ֥יִץ וּבָחֹ֖רֶף יִֽהְיֶֽה׃

passages.text: On that day the LORD will become King over all the earth—the LORD alone, and His name alone.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD will become King.
He will rule over all the earth.
This will happen on a special day.
On that day, only the LORD will be King.
Only the LORD’s name will be honored.
No one else will be King.
No other name will be honored.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־ כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִהְיֶ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶחָ֖ד וּשְׁמ֥וֹ אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: All the land from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem will be turned into a plain, but Jerusalem will be raised up and will remain in her place, from the Benjamin Gate to the site of the First Gate to the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananel to the royal winepresses.
passages.sermon:
God will change the land around Jerusalem.
All the land from Geba to Rimmon, south of Jerusalem, will become a plain.
God will raise up Jerusalem.
Jerusalem will stay in her place.
Jerusalem will stretch from the Benjamin Gate to the place of the First Gate.
Jerusalem will reach to the Corner Gate.
Jerusalem will go from the Tower of Hananel to the royal winepresses.
passages.original: יִסּ֨וֹב כָּל־ הָאָ֤רֶץ כָּעֲרָבָה֙ מִגֶּ֣בַע לְרִמּ֔וֹן נֶ֖גֶב יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְֽרָאֲמָה֩ וְיָשְׁבָ֨ה תַחְתֶּ֜יהָ לְמִשַּׁ֣עַר בִּנְיָמִ֗ן עַד־ מְק֞וֹם שַׁ֤עַר הָֽרִאשׁוֹן֙ עַד־ שַׁ֣עַר הַפִּנִּ֔ים וּמִגְדַּ֣ל חֲנַנְאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד יִקְבֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: People will live there, and never again will there be an utter destruction. So Jerusalem will dwell securely.
passages.sermon: People will live in Jerusalem.\r\nThere will never again be total destruction in Jerusalem.\r\nJerusalem will live in safety.
passages.original: וְיָ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֔הּ וְחֵ֖רֶם לֹ֣א יִֽהְיֶה־ ע֑וֹד וְיָשְׁבָ֥ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לָבֶֽטַח׃

passages.text: And this will be the plague with which the LORD strikes all the peoples who have warred against Jerusalem: Their flesh will rot while they stand on their feet, their eyes will rot in their sockets, and their tongues will rot in their mouths.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will strike all the peoples who fought against Jerusalem.
A plague will come upon them.
Their flesh will rot while they stand on their feet.
Their eyes will rot in their sockets.
Their tongues will rot in their mouths.
passages.original: וְזֹ֣את׀ תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה הַמַּגֵּפָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִגֹּ֤ף יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צָבְא֖וּ עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הָמֵ֣ק׀ בְּשָׂר֗וֹ וְהוּא֙ עֹמֵ֣ד עַל־ רַגְלָ֔יו וְעֵינָיו֙ תִּמַּ֣קְנָה בְחֹֽרֵיהֶ֔ן וּלְשׁוֹנ֖וֹ תִּמַּ֥ק בְּפִיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: On that day a great panic from the LORD will come upon them, so that each will seize the hand of another, and the hand of one will rise against the other.
passages.sermon:
The LORD will send a great panic on the people who fight against Jerusalem.
This will happen on that day.
Each person will grab the hand of his neighbor.
One person will raise his hand against another person.
passages.original: וְהָיָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא תִּֽהְיֶ֧ה מְהֽוּמַת־ יְהוָ֛ה רַבָּ֖ה בָּהֶ֑ם וְהֶחֱזִ֗יקוּ אִ֚ישׁ יַ֣ד רֵעֵ֔הוּ וְעָלְתָ֥ה יָד֖וֹ עַל־ יַ֥ד רֵעֵֽהוּ׃

passages.text: Judah will also fight at Jerusalem, and the wealth of all the surrounding nations will be collected—gold, silver, and apparel in great abundance.
passages.sermon:
Judah will fight in Jerusalem.
The people of Judah will join the battle.
They will fight against the enemies of Jerusalem.
The wealth of all the nations around Jerusalem will be gathered.
This wealth will include gold.
It will include silver.
It will include many clothes.
There will be a great abundance of these things.
passages.original: וְגַ֨ם־ יְהוּדָ֔ה תִּלָּחֵ֖ם בִּירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְאֻסַּף֩ חֵ֨יל כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֜ם סָבִ֗יב זָהָ֥ב וָכֶ֛סֶף וּבְגָדִ֖ים לָרֹ֥ב מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: And a similar plague will strike the horses and mules, camels and donkeys, and all the animals in those camps.
passages.sermon:
God will send a plague.
This plague will strike the animals in the enemy camps.
Horses will suffer from the plague.
Mules will suffer from the plague.
Camels will suffer from the plague.
Donkeys will suffer from the plague.
All other animals in those camps will suffer from the plague.
The plague on the animals will be like the plague on the people.
passages.original: וְכֵ֨ן תִּֽהְיֶ֜ה מַגֵּפַ֣ת הַסּ֗וּס הַפֶּ֙רֶד֙ הַגָּמָ֣ל וְהַחֲמ֔וֹר וְכָ֨ל־ הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה בַּמַּחֲנ֣וֹת הָהֵ֑מָּה כַּמַּגֵּפָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃

passages.text: Then all the survivors from the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up year after year to worship the King, the LORD of Hosts, and to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.
passages.sermon:
Many nations attacked Jerusalem.
Some people from these nations survived.
These survivors will go to Jerusalem every year.
They will worship the King.
The King is the LORD of Hosts.
They will also celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כָּל־ הַנּוֹתָר֙ מִכָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם הַבָּאִ֖ים עַל־ יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְעָל֞וּ מִדֵּ֧י שָׁנָ֣ה בְשָׁנָ֗ה לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺת֙ לְמֶ֙לֶךְ֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְלָחֹ֖ג אֶת־ חַ֥ג הַסֻּכּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: And should any of the families of the earth not go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of Hosts, then the rain will not fall on them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is the King.
He rules over all.
Jerusalem is the place where people worship Him.
All the families of the earth must go up to Jerusalem.
They must worship the King, the LORD of Hosts.
If any family does not go up to Jerusalem,
If they do not worship the LORD of Hosts,
Rain will not fall on them.
passages.original: וְ֠הָיָה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־ יַעֲלֶ֜ה מֵאֵ֨ת מִשְׁפְּח֤וֹת הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֶל־ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֔ת לְמֶ֖לֶךְ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְלֹ֥א עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם יִהְיֶ֥ה הַגָּֽשֶׁם׃

passages.text: And if the people of Egypt will not go up and enter in, then the rain will not fall on them; this will be the plague with which the LORD strikes the nations who do not go up to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is the King.
He commands all nations to go up to Jerusalem.
He commands them to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.
If the people of Egypt do not go up to Jerusalem,
If they do not enter in to worship the LORD,
The LORD will send a plague on them.
This plague is the same one the LORD will use against any nation that does not go up to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.
passages.original: וְאִם־ מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת מִצְרַ֧יִם לֹֽא־ תַעֲלֶ֛ה וְלֹ֥א בָאָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה הַמַּגֵּפָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִגֹּ֤ף יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יַֽעֲל֔וּ לָחֹ֖ג אֶת־ חַ֥ג הַסֻּכּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: This will be the punishment of Egypt and of all the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD of Hosts.
God commands all nations to go up to Jerusalem.
God commands them to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.
Egypt may refuse to go up.
Other nations may also refuse to go up.
God will punish Egypt if they do not go up.
God will punish every nation that does not go up.
This punishment will come because they do not celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.
passages.original: זֹ֥את תִּהְיֶ֖ה חַטַּ֣את מִצְרָ֑יִם וְחַטַּאת֙ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יַֽעֲל֔וּ לָחֹ֖ג אֶת־ חַ֥ג הַסֻּכּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: On that day, HOLY TO THE LORD will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, and the cooking pots in the house of the LORD will be like the sprinkling bowls before the altar.
passages.sermon:
On that day, the LORD will show His holiness to everyone.
People will see the words "HOLY TO THE LORD" on the bells of the horses.
The horses will carry this message everywhere.
The cooking pots in the house of the LORD will also be holy.
These pots will be as holy as the sprinkling bowls used before the altar.
Everything in the house of the LORD will be set apart for Him.
passages.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶה֙ עַל־ מְצִלּ֣וֹת הַסּ֔וּס קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָ֑ה וְהָיָ֤ה הַסִּירוֹת֙ בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה כַּמִּזְרָקִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

passages.text: Indeed, every pot in Jerusalem and Judah will be holy to the LORD of Hosts, and all who sacrifice will come and take some pots and cook in them. And on that day there will no longer be a Canaanite in the house of the LORD of Hosts.
passages.sermon:
Every pot in Jerusalem will be holy to the LORD of Hosts.
Every pot in Judah will be holy to the LORD of Hosts.
All who offer sacrifices will come.
They will take pots from Jerusalem and Judah.
They will cook in these pots.
On that day, no Canaanite will be in the house of the LORD of Hosts.
passages.original: וְ֠הָיָה כָּל־ סִ֨יר בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֜ם וּבִֽיהוּדָ֗ה קֹ֚דֶשׁ לַיהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּבָ֙אוּ֙ כָּל־ הַזֹּ֣בְחִ֔ים וְלָקְח֥וּ מֵהֶ֖ם וּבִשְּׁל֣וּ בָהֶ֑ם וְלֹא־ יִהְיֶ֨ה כְנַעֲנִ֥י ע֛וֹד בְּבֵית־ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃
